04 / Timeline + pricing

Zero to live Lark bot,
typically 3-4 weeks.

WK 1-2 · SETUP

Environment + permission mapping

Deploy Hermes Gateway in customer DC. Lark admin configures the bot app. Department/role → KB paragraph-level permission map.

WK 3 · UAT

Small-scope rollout

1-2 departments go first. Daily feedback, prompt + permission tuning. End-of-day list of unanswerable questions.

WK 4 · GA

GA + training

All-hands rollout + a 30-min usage training. One engineer stays on-site for 30 days to triage.

PRICING

¥120K - ¥350K

Includes Hermes Gateway deploy + Lark/DingTalk dual-platform + training + 30-day on-site. Final price scales with size / data / customization.
